verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents official SDKs in 15+ languages, including TypeScript, .NET and Java, plus React and Next.js integrations, and says it manages flags across web, mobile, and server-side apps. Its docs also distinguish server-side from client-side SDK access. Consistent behavior is only implied, through the shared Flagsmith Engine (Edge Proxy) and the CLI evaluating flags 'the way an SDK would'. Missing for 10: named mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/Flutter), explicit documentation that flag evaluation is consistent across SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
